title: 第一卷 第3章 好爱害羞的男人-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》
content:
第(1/3)页

    第二日早上八点，刚吃完饭，霖多多就钻进仓库，从老旧的樟木衣柜里翻出一套叠得整整齐齐的旧衣服和一双黑色雨靴，交给了上官程。

    上官程一手托着衣服，一手拎着雨靴，面露疑惑：“主人，这是……要我换上吗？”

    “当然啊！”霖多多点点头，上下指了指他那一身笔挺的西装，“进山干苦力，哪有穿西装皮鞋的？这是我姥姥亲手给我姥爷做的登山装，纯棉帆布，结实耐磨，质量特别好。”

    她目光里带着几分怀念：“我姥爷进山采药或是打野味儿的时候都穿着它。就是……可能有点短，但胖瘦应该差不多。靴子偏大码，你穿上应该刚刚好。”

    上官程低头看着那洗的发白的藏蓝色布料和磨破边的黑雨靴，十分抗拒。

    他从小到大，哪件衣服不是高奢品牌的当季新款？做任务时的一千次人生，也大多非富即贵。什么时候穿过这种旧衣旧鞋？

    抗拒的情绪像潮水一样涌上来。

    但很快，他又将它压了回去。

    罢了罢了。

    旧虽旧，但封存严密，还算干净。

    为了能报仇，忍了！

    见上官程蹙眉盯着手中那套旧衣，迟迟没有动作。霖多多误以为这bug遍布的机器人不知道该怎么更换衣物，于是好心的上前帮忙。

    整日绘画的手指灵巧而轻柔，很快便解开了两颗。

    “有胸肌？”

    霖多多看着上官程胸口隐约的沟线，眼神微眯，暗暗嘀咕：家政机器人不是只有头和手臂是仿真的，其他地方全金属皮吗？难道这个不一样？连衣服底下也都是仿真的？！

    她不由加快了手上动作，迫不及待想看清里面的风景。

    可刚又解开一颗纽扣，上官程猛然反应了过来，触电般避后一步！眼神惊慌的看着她：“你，你干什么解我扣子？”
    第(1/3)页

At eight o'clock in the morning the next day, just after dinner, Lin Duoduo went into the warehouse, dug out a neatly folded set of old clothes and a pair of black rain boots from the old camphor wood wardrobe, and handed them to Shangguan Cheng.

Shangguan Cheng held his clothes in one hand and his rain boots in the other, with a puzzled look on his face: "Master, is this... do you want me to change into it?"

"Of course!" Lin Duoduo nodded and pointed up and down at his crisp suit, "How can one wear a suit and leather shoes when working hard in the mountains? This is a mountaineering suit made by my grandma for my grandpa. It is pure cotton canvas, strong and wear-resistant, and the quality is particularly good."

There was a bit of nostalgia in her eyes: "My grandpa wore it when he went into the mountains to collect herbs or hunt game. It's just... it may be a bit short, but he should be about the same size. The boots are a bit larger, so they should be just right for you."

Shangguan Cheng looked down at the washed white navy blue fabric and the frayed black rain boots, and was very resistant.

Since he was a child, which piece of clothing has not been a new seasonal model from a high-end luxury brand?In a thousand lives when doing tasks, most of them are either rich or noble.When did you wear these old clothes and shoes?

Resistance surged up like a tidal wave.

But soon, he pushed it back again.

That’s all.

Although it is old, it is well sealed and relatively clean.

In order to take revenge, I endured it!

Seeing Shangguan Cheng frowning and staring at the old clothes in his hand, he made no move.Lin Duoduo mistakenly thought that this bug-ridden robot didn't know how to change clothes, so he kindly stepped forward to help.

The fingers that had been painting all day were nimble and gentle, and they quickly untied two of them.

"Do you have breast muscles?"

Lin Duoduo looked at the faint groove line on Shangguan Cheng's chest, narrowed his eyes slightly, and muttered secretly: Isn't it true that only the head and arms of the housekeeping robot are simulated, and the rest of the robot is made of metal skin?Is this different?Even the clothes underneath are simulated?!

She couldn’t help but speed up her hand movements, eager to see the scenery inside clearly.

But just as he unbuttoned another button, Shangguan Cheng suddenly reacted and took a step back as if he was electrocuted!He looked at her with panic in his eyes: "You, why are you unbuttoning me?"
